purpose: Read-only original-source acquisition and provenance for evidence-organization learning. No personal medical, legal or financial advice; no life intervention.

acquisition.method: git clone --no-checkout --filter=blob:none, then git show fixed_commit:path for selected text blobs
acquisition.scope: 11个原始文件按固定版本取得；本练习包附4个相关文件，主实验只读取其中README、第4节正文及其核实记录。

repo_findings.finding: README self-reports 658 entries across 34 chapter files; totals and A/B/C counts were not independently recounted across every chapter in this source task.
A is a project-specific provenance/evidence category and expressly does not establish causality. The author-defined cost-benefit category is a separate judgment, not research evidence.

The skill requires locating chapter entries, reading the entire entry including caveats, tracing numbers and conclusions to entries, and admitting when the book lacks an answer. It treats different outcome dimensions separately.
docs/引用对照.md describes internally generated entry-to-entry cross references; it is not a DOI bibliography. No supplied repository checker was executed.

Chapter-4 verification notes are dated 2026-09-07 and partly retain older numbering: Whillans is verification entry 9 but current book entry 14; Lane is verification entry 12 but current book entry 17. Join with DOI/title plus version, not entry number alone. Selected entries 6/7 are still aligned.

selected_samples.verification_path: docs/核实记录/04-不要浪费时间.md
selected_samples.lesson: Separate two observational meeting studies from the author's inference that writing asynchronously replaces meetings. The repository explicitly labels the latter as the author's inference. Do not claim an exhaustive literature search established absence of every direct comparison, and do not infer a universal net time saving.

selected_samples.verification_path: docs/核实记录/04-不要浪费时间.md
selected_samples.lesson: The repository says Kruger/Evans was only abstract-checked for direction; no exact experimental percentage was established. An answer asking for a fixed percent must abstain. Reading an abstract establishes neither full-paper review nor universal effectiveness.
